paths.title: Blood Moon Stalker
paths.description: Lean into your beast form and let instinct do the thinking. Spending an action point in beast form adds a free melee basic attack, and dropping a foe lets you catch your breath with second wind. A burst of claws punishes bloodied enemies, while a keener claw edge widens your critical range at higher levels. Your daily strike is a brutal gamble against a wounded target, and a glowing-eyed rerolling gift keeps you on the hunt when attacks go astray.

paths.title: Coiled Serpent
paths.description: Slip through the undergrowth as a serpent, wrapped in poison resistance and a bonus to Stealth while in beast form. Action points leave your targets suffering ongoing poison, and your melee strikes drip extra venom from the paragon tier onward. You can coil around a foe to grab it and turn aside attacks, slither away behind concealment, and finally call spirit serpents that daze enemies and make every attack they attempt cost them dearly.

paths.title: Formless Predator
paths.description: Cast off a fixed shape and let your body flow like a chaos beast. Wild shape can give you an aberrant appearance and a burst of damage, and an action point can end a harmful effect while shifting you slightly. At higher levels you carry a beast form keyword over to a favored at-will attack. Your powers let you pour through the battlefield with a daze-inflicting pseudopod, shrug off polymorph and petrifying effects, and finally dissolve a foe into blinded, steadily worsening agony.

paths.title: Guardian of the Living Gate
paths.description: Stand watch against corruption that does not belong in the world, striking at foes who fight alone and shielding allies from lingering afflictions. Area attacks grant you combat advantage against isolated targets, and an action point lets you or an ally attempt a saving throw with a bonus. When you fail, a nearby ally gets a save of its own. Your three wards curse an enemy with sharper aim for your primal attacks, steel your companions against its effects, and tear a target apart with ongoing damage that spreads.

paths.title: Inner Circle Initiate
paths.description: Rise within your circle as a keeper of storm and thorn. When you spend an action point, extra damage scales with the number of targets you strike, and your nature's growth power shelters an ally with temporary hit points. Thorny vines punish foes who stand in your zone by exposing them to attack, and at higher levels bloodied fury lashes anyone who lingers beside you. Your signature daily calls a roaming cyclone of lightning and thunder across the battlefield.

paths.title: Keeper of the Hidden Flame
paths.description: Awaken the hidden spark of ferocity in everyone around you, yourself included. A small accuracy edge against the nearest enemy and a reroll on an action point turn reward bold play, while a roar of wrath boosts your allies' attacks and damage. You can drag a foe across the field and knock it prone, then later overwhelm another with a beast spirit that makes it lash out at its own side. Your presence even lets allies shift into a charge together.

paths.title: Luminescent Swarm
paths.description: Fill the air with glowing insects that guard your allies and baffle your foes. While in beast form you shed bright light that sharpens your companions' saving throws, and an action point makes your swarm attacks burn with extra radiant damage. Mesmerizing lights daze and shuffle enemies, and a clarifying glare strips away concealment. Changing back to humanoid form can leave an enemy wary of striking you, and your greatest swarm assaults three defenses at once with blindness, ongoing radiance, and forced movement.

paths.title: Nocturnal
paths.description: Hunt through the boundary between the world and its shadows, passing through obstacles as you charge a visible enemy. An action point spent on a successful at-will attack can send you straight into another charge, while a brutal follow-up blow grants temporary vitality. Shadow packmates flank enemies alongside your companions, and your later gifts let you spend a healing surge to move through solid barriers or leave lingering necrotic and poisonous wounds with every melee hit.

paths.title: Pack Lord
paths.description: Lead your summoned beasts as the head of a vast hidden pack. Having a summoned creature nearby sharpens your attacks and defenses, and an action point lets you issue a command and trigger its instinctive effect. A bloody-fanged strike orders one of your creatures into battle, while a daily howl lets you command another attack each round. With greater experience your creatures regenerate when bloodied, and you finally gain an extra summoning power to call yet another ally.

paths.title: Primal Mapper
paths.description: Carry the lay of the land in your mind and turn that knowledge into freedom of movement. Action points and second wind let you move or shift as part of the effect, and from the paragon tier onward difficult terrain no longer slows you. You can conjure spectral pale wolves when an at-will attack connects, hamper enemy footing while easing your allies', and later mark a foe with a hunt that leaves it no place to hide behind concealment.

paths.title: Shadow Dancer
paths.requirements: Trained in Stealth; teleportation at-will or encounter power
paths.description: Move like living shadow, appearing wherever your enemies least expect. Spending an action point lets you teleport before or after an attack, and any teleport during your turn gives you combat advantage on your next attack roll. Shadowy tendrils drag a target through space while dazing it, and you can step through an enemy's own shadow to arrive beside it at once. Later, hidden creatures lose sight of you altogether, and your greatest leap leaves a freezing zone of darkness in your wake.

paths.title: Sky Hunter
paths.description: Take to the air as a raptor, diving at enemies who thought themselves safe from your claws. You gain accuracy against flyers, and spending an action point lets you fly your speed before the extra action. Blinding talons let you swoop and strike without provoking, a falcon form carries you above the battle with sharpened senses, and a dire eagle's wingbeats batter and slow whole groups of foes. Using a daily beast form power also heightens your Perception.

paths.title: Spiral Wind's Ally
paths.description: Befriend an ancient wind and become a healer who stays comfortable in humanoid form. Bloodied allies near you recover extra hit points whenever they spend a healing surge, and an action point can offer one of them a surge outright. Crisscrossing gusts hurt your enemies while mending your friends, and a sudden breeze hides allies who catch their breath. Spending a surge yourself lets you shift away, and your greatest wind can slow, daze, or heal as you choose.

paths.title: Steadfast Sentinel
paths.description: Fight alongside your animal companion as a mobile guardian of the wilds. You ignore difficult terrain, gain extra uses of combined attack, and spend action points to move yourself or an ally across the field. A healing boon grants regeneration while bloodied and a surge of recovery, a disguise power lets you take any humanoid appearance, and your greatest harmony wraps allies in an aura that speeds their healing while punishing enemies who attack.

paths.title: Vermin Lord
paths.description: Embrace the infestation within you and let swarming vermin fight on your behalf. Your action points burn adjacent enemies with poison and fortify nearby allies, and you gain strong poison resistance. Maggots erupt from your foes to leave them vulnerable, a shared hive mind lets your party communicate and resist flanking, and your primal attacks grant brief flight on swarm wings. Your daily power dissolves your body into a ravenous cloud that poisons and drags its prey along.

paths.title: Whirling Samara
paths.description: Scatter yourself into a flexible cloud of seeds, leaves, and wings, and move through combat unhindered by anything that would push you aside. An action point lets you reroll attacks at the price of a little damage, and changing into beast form on your turn briefly grants flight. Spinning blades guard an ally with temporary hit points, a short insubstantial surge helps you slip through enemies, and your greatest burst of seeds blinds foes and leaves your beast form quick on its feet, blinding anything you critically hit.
